title: Spot the difference: garden
prompt: Three things changed between the two garden pictures. Which list names all three changes?
explanation: Compare the two pictures bit by bit: The frog changed colour from green to plain, the purple snail changed colour from brown to purple and the orange fox vanished. Nothing else is different.
